about.title: Clovis Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Clovis recorded one traffic death in 2025, alongside 356 injury collisions across the city. For the family behind that one, the number is everything. Wrongful death claims in Fresno County are not only about crashes on Shaw Avenue or Herndon Avenue; a fatal fall at a job site, a medication error, or a defective product can also give rise to a claim. Under California law, the right to bring that claim belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and to the children; certain dependents and heirs may qualify when there is no one in that first group. The clock runs two years from the date of death, and it moves faster when a city, county, or state agency is involved. What can be recovered includes funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Clovis families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, so asking questions does not add another bill.

whyChoose.title: Why Clovis Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can tell you quickly whether you are in that group.

items.title: The deadline is not the same for everyone
items.desc: Most families have two years from the date of death, but claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Getting connected early keeps that door open.

items.title: Losses that go beyond receipts
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs matter, but so do lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. The attorneys we work with take on these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The fatal crash happened on Clovis Avenue and a police report was filed. Does that report decide our case?
items.answer: No. A Clovis Police or CHP report is one piece of evidence, but a wrongful death claim is a separate civil matter that weighs fault on its own terms. Even if the report is incomplete or points in a direction you disagree with, an attorney can gather other evidence such as witness accounts, vehicle data, and scene photos.

items.question: There is a criminal case against the driver. Do we have to wait for it to finish?
items.answer: You do not. A wrongful death action is a civil claim brought by the family and runs independently of any criminal prosecution in Fresno County. The two can proceed at the same time, and the outcome of one does not automatically control the other. Because the two-year deadline keeps running, waiting on the criminal court can be risky.

items.question: I cannot afford a lawyer right now. What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and there is no charge to be matched with an independent attorney. The attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, which means no fee unless there is a recovery.
